Name: Abigail and Family Dialogue Overhaul
Author: sqbr
Description:
This mod makes a bunch of changes to the dialogue for Abigail, Caroline, Pierre and the Wizard:

[list]
[*]Abigail's dialogue leans more into her being a little inhuman.[/*]
[*]Rather than Abigail being implied to be the Wizard's daughter, it's implied that she has been affected by the ambient magic of the valley, and inherited some magical affinity from Caroline.[/*]
[*]Caroline used to hang out with the Wizard because she was curious about magic. She eventually decided a normal life was easier and more sensible.The Wizard is quietly bitter about this.[/*]
[*]Caroline and Pierre say they want Abigail to be "normal" because they think being weird will make her life difficult.[/*]
[*]Caroline is co-runner of the shop, and more invested in it's success. Pierre is still more ambitious in a sometimes kinda jerkass way.[/*]
[*]A married Abigail talks about going down into the mines and hanging out in the Adventurer's Guild.[/*]
[*]The Witch broke up with the Wizard because of an argument about magic, and is driven by spite rather than jealousy.[/*]
[/list]
There's a bunch of edits to existing lines and events, plus a hundred or so extra lines.

I realise that in the universe of this mod the Wizard [i]isn't[/i] Abigail's family, but it was really hard to come up with a concise name! I haven't tested it super thoroughly, let me know if you hit any bugs. 

The screenshots use sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooeys' Portraits[/url].

[b]Installation:[/b]
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Download the file and unzip.
Put it in the Mods folder.

[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
Abigail's cemetery scene crashes in the old version, and must be skipped.
fall_Fri4 Pierre dialogue is bugged

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13434]Gender Setter
[/url]Any mods which only affect characters other than Abigail, Caroline, Pierre, and the Wizard. This includes my other dialogue mods.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] though there may be some inconsistencies I didn't notice on a quick check.

This mod just changes existing dialogue, so shouldn't cause huge issues with other mods. It doesn't match very well with Canon-Friendly Dialogue, and there's too many lines in that I'd need to edit for me to want to add compatibility. It is probably broadly compatible with SVE  but I haven't checked.
